Method of Attack: Delivered via SMS phishing (smishing) with malicious Android apps
Victims called by threat actors pretending to be bank employees to assist installation
Malware requests multiple permissions to take full control of device
Intercept SMS messages to steal 2FA codes
Screen recording and casting to capture sensitive information
Unlock device locked with PIN or pattern
Abuse accessibility service to read screen content and simulate clicks
Attack Vector: SMS phishing (smishing) with malicious app download links
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious SMS messages with links to fake anti-spam apps
Calls from threat actors posing as bank employees
Mule accounts in Italy, Lithuania, and the Netherlands
